1. (Currently amended): A method of providing advertisements in a traffic message comprising: - obtaining traffic data having a traffic condition of a location description on a road network; - assessing a location reference code associated with the location description assigned by a traffic message supplier; - assessing an advertising reference code associated with the location reference code; - determining whether the advertising reference code is present; and - generating, by a processing device, a traffic message having the location reference code and the advertising reference code when the advertising reference code is present.

14. (Currently amended): A method of providing advertisement messages using location reference codes comprising: - assessing, by a processing device, a location reference code of a location description; - assessing an advertising reference code associated with the location reference code; - generating, by the processing device, an advertising message having the advertising reference code; and - providing the advertising message for broadcast to navigation systems.

25. (Currently amended): A method of providing advertisements comprising: - generating, by a processing device, a message having an advertising reference code; and - providing the message for broadcast to navigation systems, wherein the advertising reference code comprises a substantially unique code that identifies at least a portion of an advertisement stored and displayed on a recipient device of the message.

27. (Currently amended): A method of providing advertisements via a traffic channel comprising: - generating, by a processing device, a message having advertisements; and - serially transmitting the message for broadcast to navigation systems via the traffic channel.

29. (Currently amended): A method of providing advertisements using location reference codes comprising: - receiving a message from a traffic supplier, wherein the message contains a location reference and an advertising reference code; - assessing at least one advertisement associated with the advertising reference code; and - presenting the at least one advertisement to a user of the navigation system at a location based on the location reference code.
